input.bodyText:
Colleagues,

Relocating executive, corporate lease, needs to be settled by Oct 1.

- 2BR / 2BA, high-floor, light
- Upper East Side, below 86th preferred
- Full-service doorman, gym, valet a plus
- Budget around $12,000/mo, some flex for the right unit
- 12-24 month lease, pristine credit, company guarantor

What do you have available? Happy to co-broke.

Daniel Roth
Corcoran
